title: Roo Code Configuration Schema
description: Schema for Roo Code AI coding assistant configuration including .roorules file format, custom modes, and API configuration profiles.

RooruleFile.title: RooruleFile
RooruleFile.description: A .roorules project configuration file providing instructions for Roo Code AI agents

content.description: Free-form text or Markdown content containing coding conventions, style guidelines, and behavioral instructions for Roo Code agents

CustomMode.title: CustomMode
CustomMode.description: A custom Roo Code operational mode defined in .roomodes

slug.description: Unique identifier for the mode in kebab-case

name.description: Human-readable display name for the mode

roleDefinition.description: System prompt text defining the role, capabilities, and constraints of this mode

groups.description: Tool groups this mode is allowed to use

customInstructions.description: Additional mode-specific instructions appended to the system prompt

ApiConfigurationProfile.title: ApiConfigurationProfile
ApiConfigurationProfile.description: A saved AI provider and model configuration profile for Roo Code

apiModelId.description: Model identifier for the selected provider (e.g., claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219)

apiKey.description: API key for the provider (stored securely, not in files)

McpServerConfig.title: McpServerConfig
McpServerConfig.description: Configuration for an MCP server connected to Roo Code

command.description: Command to launch the MCP server process

args.description: Arguments passed to the MCP server command

env.description: Environment variables set for the MCP server process

disabled.description: Whether this MCP server is currently disabled

customModes.description: Array of custom mode definitions for the Roo Code instance
